categories.main_business_segments: The Toro Company operates in two primary business segments: Professional and Residential. The Professional segment includes turf and landscape equipment, rental, specialty and underground construction equipment, snow and ice management equipment, and irrigation and lighting products. The Residential segment focuses on walk power mowers, zero-turn riding mowers, snow throwers, replacement parts, and home solutions products. In fiscal 2023, Professional accounted for 80.7% of net sales, Residential for 18.8%, and Other activities for 0.5%.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Toro emphasizes innovation in product design, manufacturing, and engineering, with a focus on alternative power, smart-connected, and autonomous solutions. Manufacturing utilizes efficient and flexible assembly-line processes, vertical integration for key competencies (e.g., injection molding, welding, die casting), and Lean/DFM/A methods to reduce costs and improve quality. The company also leverages advanced technologies such as robotics and computer-automated equipment, and collaborates with vendors for component design and tooling.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include professional users such as golf courses, sports fields, landscape contractors, municipalities, government entities, specialty and underground construction contractors, and agricultural producers. The Residential segment serves homeowners through various retail channels. Major end markets are turf maintenance, landscaping, irrigation, snow and ice management, underground construction, and residential yard care.
categories.geographic_coverage: Toro has a global footprint, selling products in over 125 countries. Major manufacturing and sales operations are in the U.S., Mexico, the UK, Italy, Romania, Germany, Poland, Australia, and China, with sales offices in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. In fiscal 2023, international sales accounted for 20.8% of total net sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Toro operates primarily as an original equipment manufacturer (OEM), positioned downstream in the supply chain. The company designs, manufactures, and assembles finished products, distributing them through a global network of dealers, distributors, retailers, and direct sales to end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating profitable growth, driving productivity and operational excellence, and empowering employees. R&D is focused on alternative power, smart-connected, and autonomous solutions, as well as sustainability initiatives. The company pursues targeted acquisitions to enhance its technology portfolio and product offerings, and has launched multi-year initiatives like 'Drive for Five' and 'AMP' to drive growth and cost savings.
categories.revenue_model: Toro generates revenue primarily through the sale of equipment, irrigation products, and related parts and accessories. Products are sold via distributors, dealers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, home centers, rental centers, and direct/online channels. The company also offers service contracts, extended warranties, and licenses its brand for certain home solutions products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Toro competes with numerous U.S. and international companies across its markets, including some with larger or more specialized operations. Key competitive factors are product innovation, quality, reliability, pricing, customer service, brand reputation, and distribution. Toro is a principal competitor in most of its markets, with a strong brand and broad product portfolio, but faces intense competition, especially in the Residential segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal 2023, Toro reported net sales of $4.55 billion, a 0.9% increase over the prior year. The Professional segment grew 7.1%, while Residential declined 20.1%. Net earnings were $329.7 million, with adjusted net earnings of $443.5 million. The company maintains strong liquidity and has a multi-year growth target to exceed $5 billion in net sales by the end of fiscal 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Toro emphasizes innovative, high-quality, and dependable products supported by an extensive service network. Its value proposition centers on providing total solutions for outdoor environments, integrating advanced technologies, sustainability, and customer-focused design. The company differentiates through its broad product range, strong brands, commitment to R&D, and ability to serve both professional and residential markets globally.
